title: Sprint workers run on the newest Sonnet through a kb-worker agent
goal: A clone-only .claude/agents/kb-worker.md sets model: sonnet (the alias, which follows the newest Sonnet, never a pinned id or inherit) and effort: high; /kb-sprint run dispatches task and subtask subagents with subagent_type kb-worker and no model override, while S1 and S2 bugs, breakdowns of a story or bug with no tasks, the sprint review and every /kb-census subagent keep the session model. Tests named kb_worker prove each.

gates.question: What effort should kb-worker run at on the newest Sonnet?
Which subagents run on kb-worker?
options: sprint items and census phase 2 readers
everything, sprint review and census sample check included

gates.question: Which sprint items still go to the session model instead of kb-worker?
options: S1 and S2 bugs, and a story or bug with no tasks yet
an item whose done was refused twice
gates.recommendation: S1 and S2 bugs, and a story or bug with no tasks yet
gates.answer: S1 and S2 bugs, and a story or bug with no tasks yet

notes: Failure it answers: /kb-sprint run starts subagents with no subagent_type or model, so every worker is general-purpose on the session model, a mechanical task included. The agent file's model field takes sonnet|opus|haiku|fable|full id|inherit and its effort field low|medium|high|xhigh|max (skills-and-subagents.csv:26 and :35, DOC S2157); the sonnet alias follows the newest Sonnet (token-efficiency.md, 'A model upgrade under an alias'). The newest Sonnet holds only while nothing overrides the definition: the orchestrator must not pass the Agent tool's model, and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1 skips a definition's model for teammates (skills-and-subagents.md:134, DOC S-qdxfqzln). Census readers stay on the session model: a false confirmation dates a stale fact as current, and no benchmark yet shows Sonnet's fact judgements hold. kb-worker stays out of plugin.json: the plugin's agent list is tested to be kb-lookup and kb-reviewer only.
